prompt: A cube has surface area $216$ square units. What is its **volume**?
hint: Find the area of one face first.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try a similar but smaller shape (all sides ÷ 2) and look at how the formula behaves.
Find the area of one face first.
One face: $216 \div 6 = 36$, so the side is $6$.
